_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2025 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2025 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers, and pricing and delivery models are evolving.', and under 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks.', 'We are incurring significant costs to build and maintain infrastructure to support cloud-based and AI services, reducing operating margins.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'Continuing to bring to market compelling cloud-based and AI services and products that generate increasing traffic and market share.' The stock trades at 38.4x FY26E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

Live: Microsoft's own FY2025 10-K, under 'Business model competition', says 'AI technology and services are a highly competitive and rapidly evolving market, and new competitors continue to enter the market.' and that some companies compete with it 'developing, making available, or using AI models that are open' ('Some open source products mimic the features and functionality of our products.') It sells generative AI of its own: 'We are investing in artificial intelligence (“AI”) across the entire company and infusing generative AI capabilities into our consumer and commercial offerings.' The stock trades at 38.4x FY26E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing generative-AI substitution of Microsoft's software seats or search specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based solutions, content, and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience; and designing and selling devices'; 'Business model competition': 'We and our competitors continue to devote significant resources to developing and deploying cloud-based strategies and services for consumers and business customers' and 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations' (its own FY2025 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.95x; +83% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.09; conservative 2yr -8%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.8%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.4%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2025-08-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.95x (50.0% downside to Bear $262 / +17.0% upside to Bull $613) | Adj composite 2.40 vs market 3.49: gap -1.09 [OVERVALUED] | +83% above the EPP floor $286 (21x FY26E $13.64) | Conservative 2-yr case: -8.0% total (-4.0%/yr) | At 38.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $693 sits above the BULL case; unearned revenue +11.8% in Q4 FY25, forward revenues +17% (no Q1 FY26 revenue guide, Q4 FY25 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
